items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We’ve had the opportunity to do a lot of duo stuff together.

ctx.x: Yeah. He’s not that much younger than me, but Mulgrew Miller. We’ve had the opportunity to do a lot of duo stuff together. He kicks my butt every time, in a good way. There’s so many, so many young players. I know more pianists than I know other, like horn players.
Yeah, but when we interview horn players, we can ask their opinion. You mentioned somebody, Sumi Toonuka. Maybe people aren’t familiar with her. If you could . . .
